Where 'fixed' is relative to the browser window, 'absolute' is relative to the first parent element that is positioned (not static). In this case, that would be <div class="side">. Lucky you, setting the position of that to static instead of relative doesn't change anything. Not sure why it's relative in the first place.

You'll have to make the same change to <div id="container"> too, then it should work. You won't have to change the coordinates or anything.

In other words...

#container, .side {
 position: static;
}
